House Rules

The Code
of OLYMP

I

Minimum VPIP — 45%

Assessed over 200 hands. Fall short and you'll get one warning, then removal. We keep the games live.

II

One Player, One Seat

A single account per player, per table. No exceptions.

III

No Seat Switching

Changing seats mid-session during active play is prohibited.

IV

Deep Entry — 200 BB+

Long sessions and deep tables require a buy-in of 200 big blinds or more.
